description: This PHP class defines the 'NationalityService' responsible for managing nationality data within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve, save, delete, and check for existing nationalities, interacting with the DAO layer. The class also offers normalization of nationality data for external use.

classes.name: NationalityService
classes.description: Service class for managing nationality data, including CRUD operations and data normalization.

methods.name: getNationalityDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the NationalityDao instance.

methods.name: getNationalityList
methods.description: Fetches a list of nationalities based on search filters.

methods.name: getNationalityCount
methods.description: Returns the count of nationalities matching search filters.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Saves a nationality entity to the database.

methods.name: getNationalityById
methods.description: Retrieves a nationality by its ID.

methods.name: getNationalityByName
methods.description: Retrieves a nationality by its name.

methods.name: deleteNationalities
methods.description: Deletes multiple nationalities by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks if a nationality with the given name already exists.

methods.name: getNationalityArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of all nationalities for external use.
